newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINNISH JAN PAPER EXPORTS THROUGH PORTS UP 28 PCT.
newsitem.headline: FINNISH JAN PAPER EXPORTS THROUGH PORTS UP 28 PCT.

text.p: Finnish exports through ports increased 11.7 percent year-on-year in January to 2.94 million tonnes and imports through ports increased 15.7 percent to 2.78 million tonnes, the Board of Navigation said on Monday.
Exports of paper through ports increased 28 percent year-on-year in January to 0.77 million tonnes, the board said in a statement.
Exports of metals and metal products increased 6.7 percent to 0.19 million tonnes in January while exports of chemicals fell 16.7 percent to 0.19 million tonnes.
Exports of other manufactured goods increased 18.4 percednt to 0.58 million tonnes, the board said.

Among imports, crude oil increased 18.3 percent to 0.57 million tonnes and coal rose 65.1 percent to 0.46 million tonnes while imports of metal ore and concentrates fell 14.0 percent to 0.30 million tonnes, it said. --Helsinki newsroom +358-9-680 50 245, e-mail news@reuters.fi
